body: The one genuinely new engine capability in v2, and the one that removes most of the friction: chrome.cookies.getAll({url}) returns an origin's cookies INCLUDING HttpOnly given host permission, and localStorage is readable by executeScript because an unbound tab has no shim rewriting it. Means a user never has to re-sign-in to seed a persona — sign into each app once, normally, then file each login. Read the browser jar, never modify it. Spec section 7.3.
title: Engine: import a login from an ordinary tab
